partially_covered.missing: No explicit listing of all organization attributes; only address and GLN are modeled. No contact details, legal identifiers, or additional info.
ValidationConstraint class exists but lacks explicit SHACL property structure or mandatory field modeling. Directory requirements not fully formalized.

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are covered via well-defined classes and properties. CQ5 and CQ13 require enrichment for full organizational and validation details.

strengths: Deep class hierarchy with clear subclassing
Pivot classes for reification and role assignment
weaknesses: No GCAs for complex class definitions
SectionUnion uses blank node, which may cause tooling issues

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7: Missing domain/range for some properties
P22: SectionUnion blank node may be nonstandard
reasoner_risks: Hermit/Pellet may warn about blank node in disjointUnionOf

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand Organization class to include additional attributes (e.g., contact info, legal identifiers, VAT number, etc.) and link them with new data properties.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Full coverage for CQ5 and improved organizational detail

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Formalize ValidationConstraint class with explicit SHACL shapes or mandatory property restrictions to ensure CQ13 is fully addressed.
Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) for key concepts, e.g. define Buyer as Organization with BuyerRole in InvoiceMessage.
Replace blank node _:SectionUnion with a named class for easier tool compatibility.
Add more advanced property characteristics (e.g., inverse properties, cardinality restrictions) where appropriate.

summary: The ontology demonstrates strong coverage and quality, with deep hierarchies, clear reification patterns, and good use of OWL constructs. To reach full CQ coverage and robust validation, enrich organizational details and formalize validation constraints. Minor structural improvements will further enhance compatibility and expressiveness.
